requirements.text: The library management system shall ensure borrowing limits prevent members from borrowing more than 5 books simultaneously.
The library management system shall provide timely notifications for overdue books to promote accountability and safety.
The library management system shall maintain real-time inventory status to prevent double borrowing.
The library management system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The library management system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
The library management system shall implement user authentication to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The library management system shall log all transactions for audit purposes to ensure accountability.
The library management system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The library management system shall allow up to 10 simultaneous book borrow operations per member to optimize resource utilization.
The library management system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
The library management system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The library management system shall enable librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
The library management system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The library management system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall enable digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
The library management system shall track the total energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
The library management system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
The library management system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members.
The library management system shall provide a mechanism to report and manage overdue books securely.
The library management system shall allow members to update their personal information securely.
The library management system shall require strong password policies for member accounts.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The library management system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
